title: Calibration: original built-in engine against Stockfish Easy
description: Stockfish limited to 1350 Elo at 0.1 s per move (the app's Easy level) is the baseline; the candidate is the original built-in engine at depth 4. A score below 50% means the built-in engine is weaker than that Stockfish preset.
hypothesis: Measures where the original engine sits relative to a Stockfish preset; no direction assumed.
